title: Chemical Engineers
description: Design chemical plant equipment and devise processes for manufacturing chemicals and products, such as gasoline, synthetic rubber, plastics, detergents, cement, paper, and pulp, by applying principles and technology of chemistry, physics, and engineering.

tasks.text: Develop safety procedures to be employed by workers operating equipment or working in close proximity to ongoing chemical reactions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Policy drafts aided; organizational adoption human

dwas.name: Develop safety standards, policies, or procedures.

tasks.text: Troubleshoot problems with chemical manufacturing processes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Root-cause hypotheses; human verifies in the field

dwas.name: Determine causes of operational problems or failures.

tasks.text: Monitor and analyze data from processes and experiments.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Modeling aided; experimental validation human

dwas.name: Research engineering aspects of biological or chemical processes.

tasks.text: Evaluate chemical equipment and processes to identify ways to optimize performance or to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Equipment specs analysis aided; physical testing human

dwas.name: Evaluate characteristics of equipment or systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Design and plan layout of equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI models process systems; engineer validates feasibility

dwas.name: Design industrial processing systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Prepare estimate of production costs and production progress reports for management.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Generate operational reports from structured data

dwas.name: Estimate operational costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Perform tests and monitor performance of processes throughout stages of production to determine degree of control over variables such as temperature, density, specific gravity, and pressure.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Efficiency metrics are digital and analyzable by AI

dwas.name: Monitor the productivity or efficiency of industrial operations.
Conduct validation tests of equipment or processes.

tasks.text: Conduct research to develop new and improved chemical manufacturing processes.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Modeling aided; experimental validation human

dwas.name: Research engineering aspects of biological or chemical processes.

tasks.text: Determine most effective arrangement of operations such as mixing, crushing, heat transfer, distillation, and drying.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Operational methods aided; human decides

tasks.text: Develop processes to separate components of liquids or gases or generate electrical currents, using controlled chemical processes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts technical methods; expert validates feasibility

dwas.name: Develop technical methods or processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Design measurement and control systems for chemical plants based on data collected in laboratory experiments and in pilot plant operations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts control logic; engineer validates safety

dwas.name: Design control systems for mechanical or other equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Perform laboratory studies of steps in manufacture of new products and test proposed processes in small-scale operation, such as a pilot plant.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Process research aided; plant observation needs humans

dwas.name: Conduct validation tests of equipment or processes.

tasks.text: Develop computer models of chemical processes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Modeling code drafted; validation and domain framing human

dwas.name: Research engineering aspects of biological or chemical processes.
Design computer modeling or simulation programs.

tasks.text: Direct activities of workers who operate or are engaged in constructing and improving absorption, evaporation, or electromagnetic equipment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Industrial production direction is human supervisory control

emerging_tasks.task: Adapt processes to convert from small-scale laboratory operations to large-scale commercial production.
Develop process flow diagrams or pipe and instrumentation diagrams.
